row: Dr. Shawn Thistle | Chiropractic Continuing Ed

Dr. Shawn Thistle, a trusted expert in chiropractic evidence-based education since 2006, is dedicated to empowering chiropractors to achieve professional success. His unique approach combines clinical relevance with practical knowledge, offering comprehensive continuing education through weekly Research Reviews, dynamic Online Courses, in-depth e-Seminars, and engaging In-Person Seminars. As an inspiring speaker at global chiropractic conferences, Dr. Thistle helps chiropractors sharpen their skills, stay current with research, and reach new heights in patient care. Driven by a passion for helping others succeed, Dr. Thistle’s mission is to provide chiropractors with the tools and insights to grow, thrive, and transform their practice.

Subscribe for chiropractic continuing education, clinical expertise, and professional growth. 
Stay informed with up-to-date research and hands-on learning that elevates your chiropractic practice
